facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: The city of Ayodhya, twelve yojanas long and three yojanas wide, was founded by Manu.
facts.text: The Balakanda of the Valmiki Ramayana depicts Ayodhya as a fortified capital on the banks of the Sarayu river, measuring twelve yojanas in length and three yojanas in breadth.

facts.label: scripture
facts.quote: It is said that the place of birth is situated to the east of Vighnesvara, the north of Vasistha and to the west of Laumasa.
facts.text: The Ayodhya Mahatmya in the Skanda Purana delineates the sacred geography of Ayodhya and describes the location of the Janmasthana shrine in relation to the hermitages of Vashishtha and Lomasha.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: During this period, as per the directions of the Hon'ble High Court, Lucknow, 82 trenches were excavated to verify the anomalies mentioned in the report of the Ground Penetrating Radar Survey.
facts.text: Between March and August 2003, the Archaeological Survey of India excavated eighty-two trenches at the site under the orders of the Lucknow Bench of the Allahabad High Court.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The lowest deposit above the natural soil represents the NBPW period and therefore the earliest remains may belong to the thirteenth century B.C. which is confirmed by two more consistent C14 dates from the NBPW (Period I), viz. 910±100 B.C. and 880±100 B.C.
facts.text: Radiocarbon assays of charcoal samples recovered from the lowest cultural stratum (Period I) yielded dates of 910 BCE and 880 BCE, showing human habitation at the site in the early first millennium BCE.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The Northern Black Polished Ware (NBPW) using people were the first to occupy the disputed site at Ayodhya... A round signet with legend in Asokan Brahmi is another important find of this level.
facts.text: The earliest occupation layer, designated Period I, corresponds to the Northern Black Polished Ware horizon and yielded diagnostic ceramics, terracotta figurines, glass beads, and a round signet inscribed in Ashokan Brahmi characters.

facts.label: archaeology
facts.quote: The ASI report said during the early medieval period (11-12th century AD) a huge structure of nearly 50 metres, with north-south orientation, was constructed.
facts.text: The ASI documented an underlying building complex measuring approximately fifty metres in length along a north-to-south orientation, which it dated to the eleventh or twelfth century CE.

facts.label: legend
facts.quote: Local tradition averred that Raja Vikramaditya rebuilt the city and erected a magnificent temple supported by eighty-four pillars of black stone called kasauti.
facts.text: Local traditions in the Faizabad district maintained that the legendary King Vikramaditya had rebuilt the sacred city of Ayodhya and established a royal shrine supported by eighty-four pillars of black stone.

scenes.vo: Ayodhya ki zameen ke sabse neeche, ek mutthi koyla mila. Us koyle ne ek tareekh batayi, 910 BCE. Yaani Isa se 910 saal pehle bhi, yahaan log rehte the, chulha jalate the. Yeh kisi kahani ki baat nahi, yeh lab ki report hai.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: explaining_front

scenes.vo: Yeh report Archaeological Survey of India ki hai, yaani ASI. ASI desh ki sarkari sanstha hai, jo purani jagahon ki khudai aur dekhbhaal karti hai. Lekin us report mein sirf koyla nahi tha. Kuch baaton par aaj tak vidwan bahas karte hain.

scenes.vo: Zameen ke neeche ek badi imarat ki neev bhi mili. Kuch ne kaha, yeh khambon wala ek vishal bhawan tha. Kuch ne kaha, yeh alag alag zamane ke farsh ke tukde hain. Dono taraf padhe likhe log hain, aur dono ke paas daleel hai.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Sabut ke saath chalte hain, aur shuruaat karte hain granthon se. Pehle dekhte hain ki purane granth Ayodhya ko kaise dikhate hain. Kyunki khudai ka matlab tabhi samajh aata hai. Jab pata ho ki log zameen ke neeche dhoondh kya rahe the.

scenes.label: scripture

scenes.vo: Valmiki Ramayana ka pehla hissa hai Balakanda. Usme Ayodhya ek kile wali rajdhani hai, Saryu nadi ke kinare. Majboot deewaron se ghiri hui, ek surakshit aur sundar nagar. Ramayana ke mutabik, is nagar ko Manu ne basaya tha.

scenes.label: scripture

card.line: Balakanda ke hisaab se Ayodhya ki lambai

visual.prompt: Doodle-style number card on aged palm-leaf texture with a faint outline of a walled city along a river

scenes.vo: Aur uska aakaar? Balakanda ke hisaab se Ayodhya 12 yojana lambi thi. Yojana yaani purane zamane mein doori naapne ki ikai. Aaj ke kilometre mein iska hisaab vidwan alag alag lagate hain. Par sandesh saaf hai, yeh ek vishal nagar ki tasveer hai.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: an old scholar without a name sitting by an oil lamp, unrolling a long hand-drawn pilgrimage map of a river town with tiny shrines, ashrams and ponds marked by symbols, cosy evening mood, no readable text

scenes.vo: Phir aata hai Skanda Purana, jiska ek hissa hai Ayodhya Mahatmya. Mahatmya yaani kisi teerth ki mahima aur uska naksha batane wala granth. Isme Ayodhya ki pavitra jagahon ka poora bhugol likha hai. Kaun sa sthaan kahaan hai, kaun sa ashram kis disha mein.

scenes.label: scripture

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: a stylised compass drawn on parchment with three small hermitage huts and a small shrine placed around a central glowing spot, arrows showing east, north and west, curious mood, no text

scenes.vo: Isi granth mein Janmasthan ki jagah bhi dishaon se batayi gayi hai. Woh Vighneshwar ke poorab mein hai, aur Vashishtha ke uttar mein. Saath hi Lomash rishi ke ashram ke pashchim mein. Yaani granth ek tarah ka purana naksha deta hai, bina kisi map ke.

scenes.label: legend

scenes.vo: Granthon ke alawa, logon ki zubaani kahaniyan bhi hain. Faizabad ke purane District Gazetteer mein aisi ek kahani darj hai. Gazetteer yaani ek sarkari kitaab, jisme kisi zile ka itihaas aur haal likha jaata. Kahani kehti hai, Raja Vikramaditya ne Ayodhya ko dobara basaya tha.

scenes.label: legend

visual.prompt: Doodle-style number card with a faint drawing of rows of black stone pillars in mist

scenes.vo: Aur unhone ek shaandaar mandir banwaya, 84 khambon par khada. Khambe kaale patthar ke the, jise log kasauti kehte the. Dhyaan dijiye, yeh legend hai, kisi granth ya khudai ka sabut nahi. Par aisi kahaniyon ne logon ki jigyasa hamesha zinda rakhi.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Ab kahani granthon se nikal kar mitti mein utarti hai. Saal 2003, aur Ayodhya mein shuru hoti hai ek badi khudai. Is khudai par bahut logon ki nazar thi. Chaliye dekhte hain, ASI ne kya kiya, aur kaise kiya.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: a fenced excavation site under a hot summer sky, tents, measuring tapes and grid strings over the ground, workers and officials without names walking with clipboards, serious focused mood, no text

scenes.vo: March se August tak, ASI ki team ne yahaan kaam kiya. Yeh khudai apni marzi se nahi ho rahi thi. Allahabad High Court ki Lucknow bench ne iska aadesh diya tha. Isliye har kadam dhyaan se, likh kar, uthaya jaana tha.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: a technician without a name pushing a wheeled radar device across flat ground, with a cutaway view below showing glowing wavy signals bouncing off hidden shapes underground, scientific curious mood, no text

scenes.vo: Khudai se pehle ek aur jaanch hui thi, Ground Penetrating Radar survey. Yaani zameen ke andar radar bhej kar, bina khode, chhupi cheezon ki tasveer lena. Radar ne kuch jagah ajeeb nishaan dikhaye, jinhe anomaly kehte hain. ASI ko inhi nishaanon ki sachchai jaanchni thi.

scenes.label: archaeology

card.line: trench khode gaye, March se August 2003

visual.prompt: Doodle-style number card with a bird's-eye sketch of many neat square trenches in a grid

scenes.vo: Iske liye ASI ne 82 trench khode. Trench yaani khudai ka chaukor gaddha, jisme mitti parat dar parat hatai jaati hai. Har trench ek khidki jaisi thi, ateet mein jhaankne ki. Aur har khidki ne kuch na kuch dikhaya.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: a trench wall shown like a layered cake of coloured soil bands, next to it a playful inset of a stack of old newspapers yellowing toward the bottom, clear explanatory mood, no text

scenes.vo: Khudai mein mitti ki parten sabse zaroori sabut hoti hain. Parat yaani stratum, mitti ki woh tah jo ek zamane mein jamti hai. Sabse neeche sabse purani parat, aur upar nayi. Jaise ek ke upar ek rakhe akhbaar, neeche wala sabse purana.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: workers without names sieving soil baskets, an archaeologist labelling small finds in trays, another photographing a trench with a scale stick, busy careful mood, no text

scenes.vo: Team mein archaeologist the, mazdoor the, aur nigraani karne wale adhikari bhi. Mitti ki tokriyan chhaani jaati, aur nikle tukde alag rakhe jaate. Har cheez ki photo, naksha aur gehrai darj hoti. Kyunki is khudai ka har panna baad mein jaancha jaana tha.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: chapter_turn

scenes.vo: Ab aate hain asli sawaal par, mitti ne kya bataya. Shuruaat sabse neeche wali parat se karte hain. Kyunki wahi batati hai ki yahaan insaan sabse pehle kab aaye. Khudai ki kahani hamesha neeche se upar padhi jaati hai.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: close view of glossy black thin pottery shards being lifted from the bottom soil layer by careful hands, a ghostly inset of an ancient potter shaping a shiny black bowl, wonder-filled mood, no text

scenes.vo: ASI ne sabse purani parat ko naam diya, Period I. Is parat mein mile khaas bartan, Northern Black Polished Ware. Yaani kaale, chamakdaar, patle bartan, jo prachin Bharat ke shehron ki pehchaan maane jaate hain. ASI ke mutabik yahi log is jagah ke pehle basne wale the.

scenes.label: archaeology

scenes.vo: Isi parat se mitti ki murtiyan bhi mili, jinhe terracotta kehte hain. Yaani pakaayi hui mitti se bani chhoti aakritiyan. Saath mein kaanch ke manke mile, jo shaayad gehne mein pirote jaate the. Har cheez batati hai ki yahaan ek basti thi, sirf padaav nahi.

scenes.label: archaeology

visual.prompt: Doodle-style panel, 16:9: a small round clay signet resting on an archaeologist's palm, ancient-looking carved marks on it rendered as abstract unreadable squiggles, soft lamp light, mysterious mood

scenes.vo: Aur phir mili ek gol mohar, jis par kuch likha tha. Likhawat thi Ashokan Brahmi mein. Brahmi yaani Bharat ki sabse purani padhi ja sakne wali lipiyon mein se ek. Wahi lipi jo Samrat Ashok ke shilalekhon par milti hai. Ek chhoti si mohar, par bada sawaal, isse kisne istemaal kiya hoga?

scenes.label: archaeology

scenes.vo: Ab us koyle ki baat, jisse humne video shuru kiya tha. Period I ki parat se koyle ke tukde nikale gaye. Phir unki radiocarbon dating hui. Radiocarbon dating yaani vigyan se yeh hisaab, ki koi jaivik cheez kitni purani hai. Jaivik yaani jo kabhi zinda thi, jaise lakdi.

scenes.label: archaeology
